source: Client brief 2026-10-13: Brazil Reverse Osmosis Market -- market definition, segmentation (system type, component, use case, end-use industry) and exclusions as given by the owner; Brazil-headquartered companies only; 200 companies; 10 browsers; owner 2026-10-13: excluded / adjacent segments are left out of the report entirely (not in Other Noticeable Players); 2026-10-13: own-product scope test (a maker with its own RO line is core)
market_definition: The Brazil Reverse Osmosis Market covers reverse osmosis (RO) systems, equipment and components used to remove dissolved salts, impurities and contaminants from water through membrane-based filtration, for residential, industrial, commercial and municipal potable water production, process water, high-purity water, wastewater treatment and water reuse. System types: seawater RO (SWRO), brackish water RO (BWRO), industrial / process water RO, wastewater RO and residential RO. Components: RO membranes, pumps, pressure vessels, pretreatment systems, controls and monitoring systems, energy recovery systems and other RO components. Use cases: potable water, process water, boiler feedwater, high-purity water, wastewater treatment and polishing, water reuse and recycling, desalination, zero liquid discharge (ZLD) and concentrate management, for food and beverage, pharmaceutical and healthcare, chemical and petrochemical, power generation, oil and gas, mining and metals, pulp and paper, electronics and semiconductor, agribusiness and other industries.
core_scope: A core player is a company headquartered in Brazil that itself designs, manufactures and sells under its own name reverse osmosis systems (industrial, commercial, municipal, desalination, wastewater / reuse, laboratory or residential RO units) or RO-specific components (membranes, pressure vessels, energy recovery, RO pretreatment, RO controls) -- also when RO is one product line beside other water treatment equipment.
adjacent_segments: Conventional filtration and water treatment without reverse osmosis
Standalone ultrafiltration, microfiltration or UV disinfection not integrated into an RO system
Water treatment chemicals and consumables unrelated to RO operation
Water utilities, sanitation and general water / wastewater infrastructure or services not tied to RO systems
General-purpose pump, valve or tank makers whose products are not specific to RO
Distributors and resellers of other companies' RO equipment
scope: Brazil-headquartered companies that design, manufacture and sell under their own name reverse osmosis systems (SWRO, BWRO, industrial / process, wastewater and residential RO) or RO-specific components (membranes, pressure vessels, energy recovery, RO pretreatment, RO controls and monitoring). EXCLUDED: conventional filtration and treatment without RO; standalone UF, MF or UV not integrated into an RO system; water treatment chemicals and consumables unrelated to RO; water utilities, sanitation and general water / wastewater infrastructure or services not tied to RO; equipment used only in non-RO treatment; distributors and resellers; foreign companies' Brazilian branches, offices or subsidiaries.
